title: Practice: connect a team's MCP servers to Claude Code (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the shared file declares the four team servers with the right shape
cases.says: The shared file declares the four team servers with the right shape

cases.id: e1 credentials are read from the environment and never written in the file
cases.says: Credentials come from the environment, never from the file, and not under a name Claude Code blanks out

cases.id: e2 endpoints and paths that are not secret have a default so the file works unset
cases.says: Endpoints and paths that are not secret have a default, so the file works with nothing set

cases.id: e3 only the small core server is loaded at the start
cases.says: Only the small core server is loaded at the start

cases.id: e4 shared servers stay in the project file and personal ones in the user scope file
cases.says: Shared servers are in the project file and the personal one only in the user-scope example

cases.id: e5 permissions allow the read only servers by name and deny the destructive tool
cases.says: Permissions allow the read-only servers by name and deny the destructive tool

cases.id: e6 the tool description says when to use it instead of grep and fits the limit
cases.says: The tool description gives the boundary against Grep early and fits the limit

cases.id: e7 the notes list every server with its scope and read the catalog as a resource
cases.says: The notes list every server with its scope and read the catalog as a resource

cases.id: e8 no file holds a personal path an address or a key
cases.says: No file holds a personal path, an address or a key
